text: 6 month old boy, temp 38.4 tonight. His eczema has flared up, dry itchy bits on his arms and behind his knees, he keeps rubbing them. One eye is pink and a bit sticky with gunk in the corner this evening. His cheeks were bright red when we came in from the park, it was really windy and cold out, he goes like that every time we're out in the wind and it calmed down once he'd warmed up indoors. Mainly wondering about the temperature and the eye.
